column1: # context-2026: the Phase 3 context-labelled set, labelled under docs/benchmark/codebook.md (codebook version 4).

# Rows come from fixtures/headlines/context-2026-intake.tsv (harvested 2026-10-12 with --context-intake; no detector label was produced or read). Only rows with fetchStatus=ok are labelled so far; the rest wait for the Chrome connector.

# Labeller: a single model reviewer. For every row it read the feed summary and the cached article page (.cache/articles, git-ignored), then labelled the headline's own words against the codebook text without seeing the detector's output. Context settles facts (who is quoted, the article type, the stage of the work, what the headline holds back); it never adds a technique the headline's words do not carry (codebook section 1).

# story_link, story_facts and story_suggestion follow docs/benchmark/review-process.md. story_suggestion is filled only on unsure rows and gives the other reading. Keep the story columns hidden from the owner on random spot-check rows until the owner has chosen.
# Some headlines were still in their feeds from the beats-2026 harvest and appear there too; the note or story_facts says so where the label differs.
